articles.title: Letter: The Saturday Cleanup Day on Ridge Avenue Needs Attention
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the May meeting.
To the editor: I have lived on Ridge Avenue for 20 years, and I want to say what a difference the Kettle Hill Block Association has made.

articles.title: Letter: The Bus Shelter on Thistle Lane Needs Attention
body: To the editor: Please keep the bus shelter in the budget. Many of us on Thistle Lane use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Thistle Lane for 40 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Youth Center has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Lamar Feeney, Canal Park

articles.title: Brian Salazar, 70, Hardware Store Owner
articles.deck: Friends remember Brian Salazar for the many years of service to Kettle Hill.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Canal Park Food Pantry in his or her name.
Born in Kettle Hill in the years after the war, Brian Salazar spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
